public_edition.bibliographic_source: Wikimedia Commons describes the file as a facsimile reproduction of the first 1916 book publication (print run 6000), itself a mechanical reproduction of the novel parts published in three Sirin collections in 1913–1914.
public_edition.legal_evidence: The Wikimedia Commons file description explicitly marks the work public domain and identifies publication in the Russian Empire before 7 November 1917. The scan is used only as a candidate edition identity; no source pages or OCR are committed here.
